investor.subject: What could break this deal
investor.preheader: The one assumption that moves your cash flow most.
investor.headline: What could break this deal

body.text: Every deal has one assumption that does the most damage when it is wrong. Usually it is rent, vacancy, or the rate.

body: That is a preset stress, not a prediction. The useful question is whether you have evidence for the input: a signed lease, a rate quote, the last two years of vacancy.
Replace the estimate with what you can verify and run it again. It is free and takes a minute.
